description: Storage test vectors for annox spec §5. Each case gives a workspace's files (path relative to the workspace root → content) and a document path. Load it (§5.7.1) and compare with `expected`: `documents` maps every document id to its derived `path`, `mergedInto`, and `conflicts` (§5.5.1); `at` lists documents at the path (R); `loaded` the documents whose annotations are loaded (S); `folders` the folders read (relative to .annox/, so shared folders start with docs/ and local ones with local/docs/); `events` the annotation event ids read; `annotations` the annotation ids. All lists are sorted.

cases.name: single-document
cases.description: Two documents; loading one reads only its folder.

cases.name: nested-paths
cases.description: A document at "ch2" and one at "ch2/intro.md" are distinguished by their ~id folders.

cases.name: reply-with-root
cases.description: A reply is stored with its root and loaded with the document.

cases.name: rename
cases.description: draft.tex renamed to paper.tex with a move event and the folder moved; anchor paths still say draft.tex.

cases.name: rename-old-path
cases.description: After the rename, nothing is at the old path.

cases.name: rename-straggler
cases.description: A branch without the rename wrote an event into the old-named folder; same id suffix, so it loads.

cases.name: path-reuse-new
cases.description: main.tex renamed to old-main.tex, then a new main.tex annotated: it gets only its own annotations.

cases.name: path-reuse-old
cases.description: The renamed document keeps its annotations at the new path.

cases.name: rename-back
cases.description: a → b → a: the document is at a again.

cases.name: duplicates-unmerged
cases.description: Two branches each created a document record for intro.md; readers load both.

cases.name: duplicates-merged-straggler
cases.description: Duplicate merged into the smaller id; a straggler still in the merged folder loads via the redirect.

cases.name: concurrent-moves
cases.description: Two concurrent moves: path is conflicted; the provisional value (greatest id) is c.md.

cases.name: concurrent-moves-other
cases.description: While conflicted, the document is not at the losing path.

cases.name: ignored-files
cases.description: Temporary files, non-UUID names, invalid JSON, id/filename mismatch, folders without ~id, and cache files are ignored.

cases.name: local-with-shared-record
cases.description: A local annotation on a document with a shared record uses the shared id; its local folder has no document/ subfolder. Both areas load.

cases.name: local-record-only
cases.description: A local annotation on a document without a shared record lives with a local document record.

cases.name: local-record-published-duplicate
cases.description: A local record was published while someone else created a shared record for the same path: duplicates, both loaded (§5.8).

cases.name: merged-into-unknown
cases.description: A shared record merged into a document this reader doesn't know (e.g. someone's local record): the redirect is ignored and the record stays at its path.

cases.name: merged-into-larger
cases.description: A merged event whose target id is not smaller is invalid and ignored.
